# Reemite

Reemite is a financial technology company serving Africa and international markets. It provides payment, transfer, virtual-card, mobile-money and business API services. Reemite is not a bank; it operates through relevant licences and partnerships with regulated financial institutions and payment processors.

Its vision is to contribute to Africa's transformation through finance and the mining industry.

Reemite was founded by Prince Muloko and co-founded by Prince Lulinda.

## Public website

- [Home](https://www.reemite.com/): Reemite's mission, products and services
- [Pricing](https://www.reemite.com/pricing): Pricing information
- [Agents](https://www.reemite.com/agents): Reemite's agent network
- [International transfers](https://www.reemite.com/transferts-internationaux): Cross-border transfer service
- [Virtual cards](https://www.reemite.com/cartes-virtuelles): Virtual card service
- [Merchant payments](https://www.reemite.com/paiement-marchand): Merchant payment service
- [Contact](https://www.reemite.com/contact): Contact Reemite support
- [Sitemap](https://www.reemite.com/sitemap.xml): Public website URLs

## Languages

The public website is available in French and English. French pages use the root paths and English pages use the `/en/` prefix.
